d: Iran is widening its threats, warning that European countries could become direct targets if they allow the US to use their military bases against Tehran. From threats against European soil to fresh warnings over the Strait of Hormuz, the conflict is entering dangerous new territory. With the ceasefire hanging by a thread and Trump facing a hostile Congress after the midterms, is the Iran war heading towards an even bigger confrontation? Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
